final_message: Fixed `cp`’s Zsh completion by adding `.num_args(1..)` to its path argument. Previously, completion metadata described only one path, so completion stopped after the source operand. Added a passing regression test and documentation; seven environment-dependent `cp` test failures also occur without the fix.
assistant_messages:
I’ll inspect `cp`’s argument definitions and completion generation, then fix the cause and add a regression test.
`cp` accepts multiple paths, but its argument metadata describes only one value. Zsh therefore stops path completion after the first operand. I’ll declare the paths as variadic, matching `mv`, and test the generated Zsh completion.
Fixed `cp`’s Zsh completion by adding `.num_args(1..)` to its path argument. Previously, completion metadata described only one path, so completion stopped after the source operand. Added a passing regression test and documentation; seven environment-dependent `cp` test failures also occur without the fix.
